messages:
perf-bot: ALERT: p50 latency spike detected on qwen-mqa-prod (us-west-2). metric: inference_latency_p50=820ms (> target 150ms). Link: https://metrics/redwood/alerts/2633456789
alice: Oncall (alice) here, paging now. tagging eng-runtime and eng-sre.
bob: I'm online, looking at the runtime dashboards. p50 spike correlates with KV cache eviction rate jump.
carla: saw customer 5xx reports from tenant-acme starting ~15:06. Is this related?
eng-runtime-owner: digging. posting initial logs.
eng-runtime-owner: ```
2026-03-10T15:06:12Z INFO kv_cache_evictions: 1182340
2026-03-10T15:06:12Z WARN cont_batch_open_windows: 4821
2026-03-10T15:06:13Z ERROR inference_error: OOM while allocating kv cache segment
```
bob: That's huge. Eviction storm causing cache misses -> model cold starts -> latency/5xx.
alice: Any recent config rollouts affecting prefetch/contbatch? devops-bot, any deploys?
devops-bot: Deploy log: 2633453000 - rollout: runtime-config v2.11 -> changed PREFETCH_MAX_PREFIXES from 200 -> 2000 (auto-suggest). Deployed to us-west-2 at 14:58.
bob: 🤦 that's likely it. Raising PREFETCH caused prefetch traffic to fill KV entries and evict long-tail prefixes.
carla: Qwen-mqa has known GQA edge-case where prefix cardinality is extreme, this would amplify.
eng-runtime-owner: mitigation plan: 1) revert PREFETCH_MAX_PREFIXES to 200; 2) reduce cont_batch_window_ms from 40 -> 10 for qwen-mqa shards; 3) enable immediate kv-ttl trimming job. I'll push hotfix config and do rolling restart canary.
alice: do it. I'll open the incident doc and notify CS.
eng-runtime-owner: Applying config patch now.
devops-bot: Deploy started: runtime-config v2.12 -> revert PREFETCH_MAX_PREFIXES and cont_batch_window override for qwen-mqa. Canary targets: us-west-2-inference-1 (10%)
devops-bot: Canary success after 90s. p50 dropped to 160ms. No increase in 5xx.
devops-bot: Rollout to 100% in 3m.
bob: Monitoring... p50 trending down to 140ms. kv_cache_evictions back to baseline ~12k/min.
carla: Customer acme verified API calls succeeded. CS Sam, can you confirm outreach?
cs_sam: Reached out via email and provided interim explain + ETA for RCA. Customer impact: transient 5xx for ~10-12 minutes, roughly 2% of requests for acme org. Offering postmortem and credit.
alice: Good. Pager-bot, close paging? Any further escalations?
pager-bot: Page cleared. Severity downgraded to S2. Please complete RCA and follow-up within 72 hours.
eng-runtime-owner: Recording immediate mitigation steps in incident doc. Need follow-up actions: - Add guardrail in config-service to prevent PREFETCH_MAX_PREFIXES > 500 for MQA models; - Add regression test that simulates high prefix cardinality; - Alert if kv_eviction_rate > 100k/min.
alice: I'll do handoff to oncall-night. Summary for notes: PREFETCH misconfig -> kv eviction storm -> contbatch amplification -> p50/5xx -> rollback + cont_batch window shrink -> recovery. file: https://incidents/2633456789
carla: Also create post-incident ticket to review auto-suggest logic in UI that recommended the 2000 value.
bob: small follow-up: consider temporary fallback routing for qwen-mqa to qwen-lite if prefetch spikes occur.
cs_sam: Customer notification draft ready, send after acceptance. I'll attach to incident doc.
alice: handing off to night-oncall (dave). dave, key things: monitor kv_eviction_rate and p50, watch for any delayed evictions or cache leak. if we see reoccurence, escalate to eng-runtime.
dave: acked. Thanks team.
perf-bot: RESOLVED: p50 back within SLO for qwen-mqa-prod. Incident closed by alice.
